oracle_boundary: Latent event cause/time are accessible only to the known-truth oracle. The observed-data estimator receives only stratum, observed outcome/censor status, and observed duration.
censoring_methods: stratum-specific Aalen-Johansen with predeclared population standardization
conditional inverse-probability-of-censoring Horvitz-Thompson incidence reference using the known synthetic G(t|X)
claim_ceiling: The simulator falsifies estimator assumptions against synthetic known truth only. It does not authenticate port data or estimate real maritime waiting times.
tie_convention: If event time and administrative censor time are equal, the event is observed before censoring.
bounds_note: Lower cause incidence is observed cause share; upper is observed cause share plus the unresolved fraction. This is a broad finite-cohort bound, not a confidence interval or a certified sharp bound.

random_streams.note: Separate deterministic SplitMix64 streams prevent variable latent-event draw counts from coupling event-time and administrative-censor sequences.

reporting_delay_sweep.latent_stream: same SplitMix64 latent-event stream as OUTCOME_DEPENDENT_REPORTING_LAG
reporting_delay_sweep.purpose: Quantify Aalen-Johansen berth-CIF bias as berth-publication latency grows, without changing latent event composition.
